summary: The root ليل (layl) primarily refers to night. Related phrases include "daughters of the night" for wishes and anxieties, and "son of the night" for a thief or traveler.
lane: لَيْلٌ ذ : see نَهَارٌ . -b2- بَنَاتُ اللَّيْلِ Wishes: (T, TA in art. بنى :) and anxieties. (TA ibid.) -b3- اِبْنُ اللَّيْلِ The thief, or robber: (T in art. بنى :) and the wayfarer, or traveller. (Er-Rághib in TA in that art.) -b4- أَخُو اللَّيْلِ A nightfarer: see a verse cited voce عَدَسَ .
